294:t_1:56.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「So it's almost identical to the information from the ruins on planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$ and Dr. $$早乙女$$...」

294:t_1:57.en:
$$桂$$
「That settles the connection between the universe's collapse and $$バアル$$.」

294:t_1:58.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$桂$$ and $$モーム$$ weren't your only gains at $$スコート・ラボ$$.」

294:t_1:60.en:
$$ランド$$
「...So, what...? In the end, you wound up another million G in debt?」

294:t_1:61.en:
$$クロウ$$
「First, praise me for selling battle data from the $$翠の地球$$, paying off my $$再世戦争$$ debt, and earning unlimited use of 《$$ＣＤＳ$$》.」

294:t_1:62.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But that doesn't excuse another debt... And a million G at that...」

294:t_1:67.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, tell us how you got into debt. We might at least feel sorry for you.」

294:t_1:68.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm confident you will. The Chief trapped me again, as usual.」

294:t_1:70.en:
$$クロウ$$
「She says sending the $$リ・ブラスタ$$ to the $$翠の地球$$ cost more than expected. The bill was a million G.」

294:t_1:71.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Wasn't that... because your $$アクシオ・スコートＳＰ$$ got shot down, $$クロウ$$?」

294:t_1:72.en:
$$メール$$
「Then you brought it on yourself.」

294:t_1:73.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hold on! You got your $$バルゴラ$$ and $$ガンレオン$$! Was I supposed to fight with just the $$スコートＳＰ$$!?」

294:t_1:74.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sure you could have managed, $$クロウ$$.」

294:t_1:75.en:
$$ランド$$
「Exactly... If you hadn't been shot down, you wouldn't have ended up in debt.」

294:t_1:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm in debt... because I wasn't... good enough...?」

294:t_1:81.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I'm sorry, $$クロウ$$... But without debt, I'm sure your strength would drop by half...)

294:t_1:82.en:
$$ランド$$
(This is for your unbreakable will too... Forgive us, $$クロウ$$.)

294:t_1:83.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Understood. Then I'll stop whining and swear to defeat that million G.」

294:t_1:84.en:
$$メール$$
「Hey, $$クロウ$$... Where's $$エスター$$, anyway?」

294:t_1:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ attacked just as I arrived at $$スコート・ラボ$$.」

294:t_1:86.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then a $$時空震動$$ sent us to that strange space at the galactic center, so I couldn't find out where she was.」

294:t_1:87.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You joined up with the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ in that space.」

294:t_1:88.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then you were sent to $$火星$$ much like we were...」

294:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your unit has that famous $$いがみ合う双子$$ guy, right?」

294:t_1:91.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But we'd like to give him some time alone right now.」

294:t_1:93.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... It seems he needs time to take it all in.」

294:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Understood. ...But Earth and humanity may not have much time left.」

294:t_1:95.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All kinds of $$バアル$$ are invading from deep space, while we keep fighting $$サイデリアル$$ and its allies on Earth...」

294:t_1:96.en:
$$ランド$$
「There's just one thing to do. Crush them all.」

294:t_1:97.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So our fight is still only getting started...」

294:t_1:98.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ said you'd help us... I'll be counting on you, Mr. $$いがみ合う双子$$...)

294:t_1:106.en:
$n
「...Sorry! Is it time for the briefing?」

294:t_1:107.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No, it isn't. I just came to see how you're doing.」

294:t_1:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It looks like you still need time to sort out your thoughts...」

294:t_1:110.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't push yourself. I'll come get you when it's time to eat.」

294:t_1:111.en:
$$スズネ$$
(He sways between hope and despair... Knowing $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ lives swells his hope, but also increases his despair...)

294:t_10:3.en:
$$シン$$
「...Still, I never imagined that $$尸刻$$ was $$尸空#pilot$$'s younger sister.」

294:t_10:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Indeed... Now that you mention it, they have a similar air, but...」

294:t_10:5.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Still, it surprised me. I can't quite explain why...」

294:t_10:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Yes. Probably because she's so far from the usual image of a younger sister.」

294:t_10:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「When I hear 'younger sister,' I picture a little girl.」

294:t_10:8.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Really? I don't particularly have that image...」

294:t_10:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「It probably depends on the person.」

294:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Everyone seems to have their own feelings about younger sisters.)

294:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The 50Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s born in your hearts... I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

294:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Though even I'm imagining $$尸刻$$ calling $$尸空#pilot$$ 'Big Bro'...)

294:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A pleasure to meet you, $$万丈$$. I'm $$ＡＧ$$, $$ＤＥＭ$$'s agent robot.」

294:t_10:19.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you for that courteous greeting. I'll be counting on you, $$ＡＧ$$.」

294:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. I hope to build a good relationship with the $$破嵐財閥$$ too...」

294:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies...! I seem to have been a little off target.」

294:t_10:23.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Hey, you're a dimensional merchant who travels between parallel worlds, right?」

294:t_10:24.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Was that $$破嵐財閥$$ you mentioned related to another world's $$万丈$$?」

294:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh! Your two beautiful assistants are here too!」

294:t_10:26.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Of course. Wherever $$万丈$$ goes, there I am.」

294:t_10:27.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I'll be counting on you too, $$ＡＧ$$.」

294:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well... I'd be delighted to be counted on.」
